contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Split text on separator, trim Unicode White_Space from both edges of each field, and return a fresh array. Retain empty fields and duplicates in order. U+0085 is trimmed; U+FEFF is retained.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Separator is nonempty.
contract.outputRole: all fields in order, each edge-trimmed, retaining empty fields
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
